item.title: Held at gunpoint at 9, Iranian refugee turned pastor now prays for Iran’s hour of freedom
item.description: Pastor David Nasser described his family's harrowing 1979 escape from Iran, and he expressed hope and prayers for democracy for Iranians.

item.title: GOP senators tangle with Noem during heated hearing on her handling of deportation surge
item.description: GOP senators pressed DHS Secretary Kristi Noem during a hearing, including one who brought up her history killing animals she owns, comparing it to her poor leadership style.

item.title: GOP lawmakers mourn legendary football coach Lou Holtz
item.description: Lou Holtz's death prompted condolences from Republican lawmakers, including Tommy Tuberville, Lindsey Graham and Ron DeSantis after the Notre Dame coach died Wednesday at age 89.

item.title: Top Trump ally Steve Daines exits Montana Senate race, plans to retire
item.description: Sen. Steve Daines, R-Mont., has decided to retire from the Senate after two terms as Republicans seek to maintain their majority in the upper chamber.

item.title: British-Iranian actress asks 'where are the college campuses' protesting the Iranian regime
item.description: British-Iranian actress Nazanin Boniadi called out progressive activists who have not spoken out on the Iranian regime's human rights violations over the years.

item.title: Stealth bombers landing at UK bases 'in days' after Trump pressures Starmer: report
item.description: B-2 stealth bombers deployment to U.K. military bases signals escalation in U.S.-Israel operations against Iran. RAF Fairford and Diego Garcia prepared for strategic bombers.

item.title: Rangers unveil statue at home ballpark, reigniting historical context debate
item.description: A statue unveiling at Globe Life Field, an MLB ballpark, ignited debate over the Texas Rangers’ law enforcement history as critics urged fuller context about the past.

item.title: Keith Olbermann under fire for calling Lou Holtz a 'scumbag' after legendary coach's death
item.description: Keith Olbermann sparked outrage with an inflammatory comment about deceased coach Lou Holtz, continuing his pattern of controversial social media posts.

item.title: Millions lose power across Cuba as Trump sanctions continue to fuel ongoing energy crisis
item.description: Massive blackout leaves millions without power across western Cuba, affecting Havana and surrounding areas after electrical grid failure.
